scene.note: You read the history and the working folder before anything new goes in.

steps.note: A customer says the site no longer mentions Sundays.
One of the commits on the visit page took a line off. Its changes show the line.
That line goes back into the list of hours, exactly as it was, in a new commit.
Every commit has a short hash, its name in the history.
The hash of the commit that removed the line is the answer to Wilma's question.
The new commit's message names it, so the history points at itself.
Femi's April finds wait in the working folder, written in a hurry.
Every changed line is read, the removed ones too.
Whatever Femi did not mean to change is put right in the editor.
Only the new books go into the commit, and the rest of the list stays.
